name: KSDD2 training-set-size intervention; exploratory reused test
epochs: 12 rounds of 70 training exposures; for N>70 these are NOT 12 full-dataset epochs
sampling: balanced cyclic permutation within each class; 35+35 total per epoch; separate RNG from model RNG; 70 images unchanged baseline
bn_calibration: exactly 70 training images per checkpoint, 35/class; BN running stats reset, momentum=None; not test
purpose: isolate training diversity at identical 216 optimization updates, 12 epochs, class exposure and train evaluation budget
interpretation: exploratory recycled 1004-image test, no claims of independent confirmation; no physical-part identity proof
no_tuning: size ladder and metrics fixed before evaluation; do not use test for model/threshold selection
numerical_caveat: Previous nominally matched 3-epoch runs did not reproduce bitwise-identical checkpoints. Reusing 70 baseline prevents proving exact one-factor causal isolation.
